shell.howToPlay.steps.bust.description: The other team sees the card too. If a forbidden word slips out, they press Bust and the explaining team loses a point.
shell.howToPlay.steps.bust.title: Catch a forbidden word
shell.howToPlay.steps.describe.descripti: Each turn, the next player on a team describes the word without saying any of the forbidden words. A turn has one timer: as many cards as they can before it runs out.
shell.howToPlay.steps.describe.title: Describe the word
shell.howToPlay.steps.guess.description: Teammates shout their guesses. The host scores each card: a guess earns a point, a skip earns nothing.
shell.howToPlay.steps.guess.title: Guess out loud
shell.howToPlay.steps.join.description: Everyone joins the same voice room. The host starts Hushle and splits the room into two teams.
shell.howToPlay.steps.join.title: Join a voice room
shell.howToPlay.summary: Describe the secret word to your team without saying any of the forbidden words.
shell.howToPlay.voiceStaysOn: Hushle opens in the middle of the lobby, so you stay in the voice room while you play.
